codigos.titulo: Manifold absolute pressure (MAP) / barometric pressure sensor circuit: circuit malfunction
causas: Open signal, reference or ground wire
Fault in the 5 V reference shared with other sensors (TPS)

verificaciones.detalle: Check for corrosion and loose or bent pins; clean with electrical contact cleaner and measure again.

verificaciones.paso: Measure reference, ground and signal at the connector
verificaciones.detalle: With the ignition on, expect ≈5 V at the reference and ≈0 V at ground (typical). With the engine off, the signal should be proportional to barometric pressure.
With the engine off and ignition on, MAP should read close to the local atmospheric pressure.
Once the cause is fixed, clear the code while the motorcycle is stationary and read it again after riding. If the fault remains, the code will return.

notasMoto: On single-cylinder engines, manifold vacuum pulses strongly: MAP readings fluctuate more while running than in a car, which is normal.

codigos.titulo: Manifold absolute pressure (MAP) / barometric pressure sensor circuit: range or performance
causas: Split, loose or blocked vacuum hose
Air leak at the manifold or throttle body
Mechanical issue affecting vacuum (valves or compression)

verificaciones.detalle: With the engine off and ignition on, MAP should read close to the local atmospheric pressure.
If the sensor uses a hose, check that it is not split, kinked or loose, and contains no water or oil.

verificaciones.paso: Measure reference, ground and signal at the connector
verificaciones.detalle: With the ignition on, expect ≈5 V at the reference and ≈0 V at ground (typical). With the engine off, the signal should be proportional to barometric pressure.
With the engine idling, check the clamps and throttle-body connection to the manifold.
Once the cause is fixed, clear the code while the motorcycle is stationary and read it again after riding. If the fault remains, the code will return.

notasMoto: The ECU compares MAP with throttle position and RPM. A sustained mismatch can trigger this code even when the circuit is intact.

codigos.titulo: Manifold absolute pressure (MAP) / barometric pressure sensor circuit: low input
causas: Signal wire shorted to ground or broken

verificaciones.detalle: Check for corrosion and loose or bent pins; clean with electrical contact cleaner and measure again.

verificaciones.paso: Measure reference, ground and signal at the connector
verificaciones.detalle: With the ignition on, expect ≈5 V at the reference and ≈0 V at ground (typical). With the engine off, the signal should be proportional to barometric pressure.

verificaciones.paso: Check whether the TPS is also faulty
verificaciones.detalle: If a TPS code is also present, suspect the shared 5 V reference or sensor ground.
With the engine off and ignition on, MAP should read close to the local atmospheric pressure.
Once the cause is fixed, clear the code while the motorcycle is stationary and read it again after riding. If the fault remains, the code will return.

notasMoto: The MAP and TPS often share the 5 V reference: a short in one sensor can affect the other.

codigos.titulo: Manifold absolute pressure (MAP) / barometric pressure sensor circuit: high input
causas: Signal shorted to the 5 V reference or 12 V
Vacuum hose disconnected (the sensor always sees atmospheric pressure)

verificaciones.detalle: If the sensor uses a hose, check that it is not split, kinked or loose, and contains no water or oil.

verificaciones.paso: Measure reference, ground and signal at the connector
verificaciones.detalle: With the ignition on, expect ≈5 V at the reference and ≈0 V at ground (typical). With the engine off, the signal should be proportional to barometric pressure.
With the ignition on, expect ≈0 V (typical); a higher reading indicates resistance in the ground connection.
With the engine off and ignition on, MAP should read close to the local atmospheric pressure.
Once the cause is fixed, clear the code while the motorcycle is stationary and read it again after riding. If the fault remains, the code will return.

codigos.titulo: Manifold absolute pressure (MAP) / barometric pressure sensor circuit: intermittent
causas: Poor contact at the connector or terminals
Chafed wiring shorting when the handlebars move or under vibration

verificaciones.detalle: Check for corrosion and loose or bent pins; clean with electrical contact cleaner and measure again.

verificaciones.paso: Move the wiring loom while watching the reading
verificaciones.detalle: With the engine off and ignition on, gently move the wiring and handlebars: the MAP reading should remain steady.
With the engine off and ignition on, MAP should read close to the local atmospheric pressure.
Once the cause is fixed, clear the code while the motorcycle is stationary and read it again after riding. If the fault remains, the code will return.

notasMoto: On a motorcycle, the loom runs close to the steering and engine: vibration and heat can loosen terminals over time.

codigos.titulo: Intake air temperature (IAT) sensor 1 circuit malfunction

verificaciones.detalle: Check for corrosion, loose pins or chafed wires near the air-filter box.

verificaciones.paso: Measure the sensor with a multimeter
verificaciones.detalle: For a two-wire sensor, the signal depends on temperature; compare it with the model's service-manual table.

verificaciones.paso: Compare IAT with ambient temperature when cold
verificaciones.detalle: After the motorcycle has been off for several hours, IAT should be close to ambient and engine temperature.
Once the cause is fixed, clear the code while the motorcycle is stationary and read it again after riding. If the fault remains, the code will return.

notasMoto: On some motorcycles, the IAT and MAP are combined in one sensor: check the model parts catalogue before buying a replacement.

codigos.titulo: Engine coolant temperature (ECT) sensor 1 circuit malfunction

verificaciones.detalle: Check for corrosion, loose pins or wires damaged by engine heat.

verificaciones.paso: Measure the sensor with a multimeter
verificaciones.detalle: For a two-wire sensor, the signal depends on temperature; compare it with the model's service-manual table.

verificaciones.paso: Compare engine and intake-air temperatures when cold
verificaciones.detalle: After the motorcycle has been off for several hours, ECT and IAT should be close. A difference greater than ≈5 °C (typical) points to a sensor fault.
Once the cause is fixed, clear the code while the motorcycle is stationary and read it again after riding. If the fault remains, the code will return.

notasMoto: On air-cooled motorcycles, this sensor usually measures cylinder-head or oil temperature, not coolant temperature.
Without a reliable temperature reading, the ECU enriches the mixture and cold starting becomes difficult.

codigos.titulo: Throttle/pedal position sensor/switch 'A' circuit malfunction
causas: Open signal, reference or ground wire
Faulty sensor or one that is not equivalent to the original
Fault in the 5 V reference shared with other sensors (MAP)

verificaciones.detalle: Check for corrosion and bent or loose pins; clean with electrical contact cleaner.

verificaciones.paso: Measure the connector with a multimeter
verificaciones.detalle: Expect ≈5 V reference, ≈0 V ground and a steadily rising signal (typical).
Move through closed, half, fully open and closed positions with the engine off and ignition on.

verificaciones.paso: Confirm the installed TPS is the correct original part
verificaciones.detalle: Compare its part number with the one for this model (Model information).

verificaciones.paso: Clear the code and relearn idle
verificaciones.detalle: Follow the procedure in the model's service manual.

notasMoto: On motorcycles with ECUs exposing few PIDs (K-line, for example Delphi MT05), position is shown as a percentage of the 5 V reference: ≈10% closed and ≈90% fully open are typical for a healthy TPS.
A generic TPS may fit the throttle body without being equivalent to the original.

codigos.titulo: Oxygen sensor circuit (bank 1, sensor 1): malfunction
causas: Exhaust leak upstream of the sensor

verificaciones.paso: Inspect the sensor connector and wiring
verificaciones.detalle: The wire runs near the exhaust: check for melted insulation, corroded pins or a loose connector.

verificaciones.paso: Check for exhaust leaks upstream of the sensor
verificaciones.detalle: A leak lets air in and can make the sensor report a lean mixture when it is not actually lean.

verificaciones.paso: Check the signal with the engine warm
verificaciones.detalle: In closed loop, a healthy zirconia sensor typically switches between ≈0.1 and ≈0.9 V; in Sensors, check whether the O2 PID changes.
Once the cause is fixed, clear the code while the motorcycle is stationary and read it again after riding. If the fault remains, the code will return.

notasMoto: Many small motorcycles do not have an oxygen sensor or have an unheated one: if yours does not have one, this code does not apply and the reading should be checked.

codigos.titulo: Oxygen sensor circuit (bank 1, sensor 1): heater circuit malfunction
causas: Heater fuse blown or power supply interrupted

verificaciones.paso: Inspect the sensor connector and wiring
verificaciones.detalle: The wire runs near the exhaust: check for melted insulation, corroded pins or a loose connector.
Consult the model wiring diagram to identify its fuse.
With the sensor disconnected, measure between the two heater wires and compare with the model's service-manual value.
Once the cause is fixed, clear the code while the motorcycle is stationary and read it again after riding. If the fault remains, the code will return.

codigos.titulo: System too lean (bank 1)
causas: Air leak (manifold, throttle-body joint or vacuum hose)
Incorrect reading from the MAP, IAT or engine-temperature sensor
Exhaust leak upstream of the oxygen sensor

verificaciones.detalle: With the engine idling, check the clamps, throttle-body joint and hoses.
With the engine off, MAP should read close to atmospheric pressure.
Trims that fall sharply when revving point to an air leak; trims that rise under load point to a fuel-supply issue.

verificaciones.paso: Check the fuel filter and pressure
verificaciones.detalle: Follow the model's service manual.
Once the cause is fixed, clear the code while the motorcycle is stationary and read it again after riding. If the fault remains, the code will return.

notasMoto: On motorcycles with few PIDs, the ECU may not report fuel trims: MAP and temperature readings are then the best clues.

codigos.titulo: System too rich (bank 1)

verificaciones.detalle: A dirty or soaked filter restricts airflow and enriches the mixture.

verificaciones.paso: Compare engine and intake-air temperatures when cold
verificaciones.detalle: A temperature sensor that reads cold when the engine is warm will enrich the mixture.
With the engine off, MAP should read close to atmospheric pressure.
Check for dribbling or an uneven spray pattern; use ultrasonic cleaning if needed.
Once the cause is fixed, clear the code while the motorcycle is stationary and read it again after riding. If the fault remains, the code will return.

codigos.titulo: Cylinder 1 injector circuit: open or malfunction

verificaciones.detalle: Check for corrosion, loose pins or a broken locking tab.
With the injector disconnected, high-impedance types typically measure 10–16 Ω; compare with the service manual.

verificaciones.paso: Check the power supply with the ignition on
verificaciones.detalle: One pin should have battery voltage with the ignition on.
Once the cause is fixed, clear the code while the motorcycle is stationary and read it again after riding. If the fault remains, the code will return.

notasMoto: On a single-cylinder engine, this is the only injector: if it fails, the motorcycle will not start or will stall.

codigos.titulo: Fuel pump primary circuit malfunction

verificaciones.paso: Listen for the pump when switching on the ignition
verificaciones.detalle: It should run for a few seconds; if it does not, check the fuse and relay.
Consult the model wiring diagram.
Low voltage can affect the pump and relay.
Once the cause is fixed, clear the code while the motorcycle is stationary and read it again after riding. If the fault remains, the code will return.

notasMoto: On many motorcycles the pump is inside the tank with the fuel-level sender: check the tank connector.

codigos.titulo: Random or multiple-cylinder misfire detected
causas: Worn, dirty or incorrectly gapped spark plug
Lean mixture (air leak or injector issue)

verificaciones.paso: Inspect the spark plug and cap
verificaciones.detalle: Check the color, wear and gap against the model's service manual.
An unstable or unexpectedly falling idle can accompany misfires.

verificaciones.paso: Check for air leaks and fuel-supply problems
verificaciones.detalle: A lean mixture can also cause misfires.
Once the cause is fixed, clear the code while the motorcycle is stationary and read it again after riding. If the fault remains, the code will return.

notasMoto: If the warning light flashes, reduce engine load and investigate promptly: misfires can damage the catalytic converter.
On a single-cylinder engine, P0300 and P0301 often indicate the same issue.

codigos.titulo: Crankshaft position (CKP) sensor 'A' circuit malfunction
causas: Open or shorted wire (routed near the engine)
Damaged or dirty reluctor wheel (flywheel teeth)

verificaciones.paso: Inspect the CKP connector and wiring
verificaciones.detalle: Check for corrosion, loose pins or a wire chafed against the flywheel cover.
If the ECU does not detect RPM while cranking, it will not inject fuel or provide a spark.
With the inductive sensor disconnected, compare the reading with the model's service manual.
Once the cause is fixed, clear the code while the motorcycle is stationary and read it again after riding. If the fault remains, the code will return.

notasMoto: Without a CKP signal, the motorcycle will not start or may stall while riding.

codigos.titulo: Crankshaft position (CKP) sensor 'A' circuit range or performance
causas: Sensor dirty with metal filings or incorrectly spaced from the reluctor wheel
Interference from spark-plug or regulator wiring near the CKP lead

verificaciones.paso: Inspect the CKP connector and wiring
verificaciones.detalle: Check for corrosion, loose pins or chafed wiring.
It should not run alongside the spark-plug lead or regulator wiring.

verificaciones.paso: Inspect the sensor and reluctor wheel
